drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Please see our proposed revisions to the mutual NDA. We have kept the document concise and focused on standard confidentiality mechanics for a transaction evaluation: mutual protection obligations, customary exclusions, compelled-disclosure procedures, return/destruction of materials, and confirmation that neither party is obligated to proceed with a transaction.

Happy to turn comments quickly if you have any proposed changes.

Best,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore and evaluate a potential business transaction or relationship between them (the “Purpose”) and, in connection with that Purpose, either party may disclose Confidential Information to the other.
edits.name: Purpose

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION; OBLIGATIONS. “Confidential Information” means all non-public information disclosed by or on behalf of a party, whether in oral, written, electronic, visual, or other form, that is identified as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential given the nature of the information and circumstances of disclosure. The receiving party shall: (a) use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose; (b) protect Confidential Information using at least reasonable care and no less care than it uses to protect its own similar information; and (c) not disclose Confidential Information except to its and its affiliates’ directors, officers, employees, partners, members, managers, agents, advisors, financing sources, and representatives who have a need to know for the Purpose and are informed of the confidential nature of the information or otherwise bound by confidentiality obligations.
edits.name: Confidentiality obligations

edits.text: Confidential Information does not include information that the receiving party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes publicly available without breach of this Agreement; (b) was known to the receiving party without restriction before disclosure; (c) is received from a third party without breach of any obligation of confidentiality; or (d) is independently developed without use of or reference to the disclosing party’s Confidential Information.
edits.name: Exclusions

edits.text: If the receiving party is required by law, regulation, court order, subpoena, or similar process to disclose Confidential Information, it shall, to the extent legally permitted, provide prompt notice to the disclosing party and reasonably cooperate, at the disclosing party’s expense, with efforts to seek confidential treatment or otherwise limit disclosure. Any required disclosure shall be limited to the portion legally required to be disclosed.
edits.name: Compelled disclosure

edits.text: 3. TERM; SURVIVAL. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four (24) months from the date of signing. The receiving party’s confidentiality and non-use obligations with respect to Confidential Information disclosed during the term shall survive for three (3) years from the date of disclosure; provided that trade secrets shall be protected for so long as they remain trade secrets under applicable law.
edits.name: Term and survival

edits.text: Upon the disclosing party’s written request, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy the disclosing party’s Confidential Information, except that the receiving party may retain archival copies maintained in the ordinary course of automated backup procedures or as required by law, regulation, or internal compliance policies, subject in each case to the continuing obligations of this Agreement.
edits.name: Return or destruction

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES; NO OBLIGATION. The parties acknowledge that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be inadequate, and the disclosing party may seek injunctive or equitable relief in addition to any other available remedies. Nothing in this Agreement obligates either party to proceed with any transaction or business relationship, and neither party grants any license or other rights except as expressly stated in this Agreement.
edits.name: Remedies and no obligation

edits.text: This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding its subject matter and may be amended only in a writing signed by both parties. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is deemed an original.
edits.name: Miscellaneous
